meta.description: Premium editorial homepage with original local illustrations and a fictional offline threat dashboard, with browser-only demo content and 320/768/1440px checks. No production connection.

<?php
/** Playground fixtures only. Never install on production. */
defined('ABSPATH') || exit;
if (!defined('CYBERDAT_PLAYGROUND') || !CYBERDAT_PLAYGROUND) { return; }

add_filter('pre_wp_mail', '__return_true');
add_filter('wp_robots', function ($robots) {
    unset($robots['index'], $robots['nofollow']);
    $robots['noindex'] = true;
    $robots['follow'] = true;
    return $robots;
});
add_action('send_headers', function () {
    header('X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow', true);
});
add_action('init', function () {
    register_taxonomy('editorial_format', ['post'], [
        'label'=>'Editorial Formats', 'public'=>true, 'hierarchical'=>false,
        'show_ui'=>true, 'show_admin_column'=>true, 'show_in_rest'=>true,
        'rest_base'=>'editorial-formats', 'query_var'=>'editorial_format', 'rewrite'=>false,
    ]);
    add_rewrite_rule('^(news|analysis|guides|learning)/page/([0-9]+)/?$', 'index.php?editorial_format=$matches[1]&paged=$matches[2]', 'top');
    add_rewrite_rule('^(news|analysis|guides|learning)/?$', 'index.php?editorial_format=$matches[1]', 'top');
}, 5);
add_filter('term_link', function ($url, $term, $taxonomy) {
    return 'editorial_format' === $taxonomy ? home_url('/'.$term->slug.'/') : $url;
}, 10, 3);

CyberDat 0.3.0 + 3B · Isolated Playground Preview

Editorial homepage visual prototype. All stories and threat metrics are SAMPLE DATA. The design is pending review; no live intelligence is connected. Fixtures and accounts exist only in this browser sandbox.

Open Gutenberg editor Open site

Loading preview…

Checks run inside real browser frames at CSS viewport widths 320, 768 and 1440 pixels. They check overflow, navigation state/focus, grid columns, block rendering and one H1. They do not certify visual quality, contrast, screen-reader behavior or Core Web Vitals. Inspect screenshots and the actual Gutenberg editor manually.
